source:
@@U02675@@
Or, if you like, ascend! It’s all the same. Leave behind the created world and enter the unbound world of pure forms, and find pleasure in what has long ceased to be. They will swirl about you like drifting clouds; but you have only to brandish the key to keep them away.

@@U02677@@
(Enthusiastically.)

@@U02678@@
Right! Grasping it firmly now I feel new strength! My chest expands! On to the Great Work!

@@U02680@@
When you see a glowing tripod, you'll know you have reached the deepest of all depths. By its gleam you will see the Mothers. Some will be seated, others standing or strolling— as chance will have it. Formation, transformation: Eternal Mind’s eternal conservation. They're swarmed around by all of creation’s creatures, but all they see are empty forms: you wont be seen. Be bold, the danger is great. Walk straight to the tripod and touch it with the key. (浮士德, with the key, assumes a decidedly commanding attitude as 梅菲斯特 watches him.) That’s the way! Like an honorable servant it will connect and follow you. Good fortune will raise you up, and before they notice, you'll be back here with it.
translation:
@@U02675@@
或者，如果你愿意，可以上升！都是一样的。离开创造的世界，进入纯粹形式的无拘无束的世界，并在早已不复存在的事物中寻找乐趣。它们会像流云一样围绕着你；但你只需挥舞钥匙就能将它们赶走。

@@U02677@@
（热情地。）

@@U02678@@
对了！现在紧紧抓住它，我感受到了新的力量！我的胸膛扩大了！继续伟大的工作！

@@U02680@@
当您看到发光的三脚架时，您就会知道您已到达最深处。通过它的光芒，你会看到母亲们。有些人会坐着，有些人会站着或散步——如果有机会的话。形成、变化：永恒心的永恒守恒。他们被所有造物的生物包围，但他们看到的只是空虚的形式：你不会被看到。大胆一点，危险很大。径直走到三脚架前，用钥匙触碰它。 （拿着钥匙的浮士德在梅菲斯特注视着他的时候，摆出一种坚决的命令态度。）就是这样！就像一位尊贵的仆人一样，它会连接并跟随您。好运会让你振作起来，在他们注意到之前，你就会带着它回到这里。
